exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret
exercises.description: Play 1234 fingers up and down the strings. Work on keeping your fingers close to the strings when not playing, and keep as little silence as possible between notes.

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (4321)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise that runs the pattern backwards, playing 4321 fingers in the process.

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (2341)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise that starts on your second finger and plays 2341 from there.

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (3412)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise where you play 3412 fingers up and down the strings.

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (4123)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise that uses the fingers 4123 up and down all 6 strings

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (1243)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise that begins with your 1st and 2nd fingers, then reverses the last two, forming a 1243 pattern.

exercises.title: One Finger Per Fret (1342)
exercises.description: Here's a variation of the 1234 finger exercise that uses the fingering 1342 up and down the strings.
